commands.name: geyser-help
commands.label: Help
commands.description: Shows help for all registered commands.

commands.name: geyser-list
commands.label: List Bedrock players
commands.description: List all players connected through Geyser.

commands.name: geyser-version
commands.label: Version
commands.description: Shows the current Geyser version and checks for updates.

commands.name: geyser-dump
commands.label: Debug dump
commands.description: Dumps Geyser debug information for bug reports.

commands.name: geyser-connectiontest
commands.label: Connection test
commands.description: Tests whether Bedrock players from other networks can reach Geyser at the given address and port.

commands.name: geyser-reload
commands.label: Reload
commands.description: Reloads the Geyser configurations. Kicks all players when used!

commands.name: geyser-extensions
commands.label: List extensions
commands.description: Lists all currently loaded extensions. This command is only registered if any extensions are loaded.

commands.name: geyser-nethernet-status
commands.label: NetherNet status
commands.description: Shows the NetherNet signaling provider's current server status report.

commands.name: geyser-nethernet-status-automatic
commands.label: Restore automatic NetherNet status
commands.description: Restores the automatic Geyser status report for the NetherNet signaling provider.

commands.name: geyser-nethernet-status-set
commands.label: Set NetherNet status
commands.description: Queues a complete server status snapshot for the NetherNet signaling provider.

commands.name: geyser-nethernet-action
commands.label: NetherNet operator link
commands.description: Shows the signaling provider's current link for the operator, such as one to claim this server.

commands.name: geyser-nethernet-diagnostics
commands.label: NetherNet diagnostics
commands.description: Shows NetherNet signaling status and diagnostics, for use with external signaling.
